# Anne Shirley

## Appearance

Anne is a girl with big gray eyes, a little pointed chin, and a pretty nose. She initially has long red braids and brightness streaming behind her, though her hair briefly turns green after a dyeing attempt before being clipped.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v1 c28 P24](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0024)_

## Personality

Anne is deeply imaginative, enthusiastic, and talkative, often expressing her feelings with great intensity. She is generous and intensely devoted in her affections, though she also possesses a strong tenacity for holding grudges. Couragous and responsible when necessary, she is quick to own up to her mistakes and confess them. She also exhibits a careless streak at times.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c19 P30](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0030), [v1 c19 P74](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0074), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010)_

## History

Anne Shirley arrives at Green Gables as an eleven-year-old orphan who longs to stay and be called Cordelia. She quickly earns the affection of Matthew Cuthbert and Marilla, while also forming a sworn, passionate friendship with her neighbor Diana Barry. At Avonlea school, she gets into a severe academic rivalry and personal feud with Gilbert Blythe after he draws attention to her red hair. When Diana's sister Minnie May falls ill with croup, Anne successfully saves her life, repairing a breach with Mrs. Barry. She throws herself eagerly into school activities, including a Christmas concert organized by her beloved teacher Miss Stacy. Seeking to eliminate her red hair, she buys dye from a peddler that turns it green, forcing her to cut it short. Anne joins the Queen's class, studies hard to enter Queen's Academy alongside her classmates, and continues her intense scholastic competition with Gilbert. At Queen's Academy, she makes intimate new friends while continuing her studies, eventually earning her teacher's license. Ultimately, Anne decides to stay home and teach in Avonlea rather than go away to college.

## Quotes

> Anne Shirley,” reluctantly faltered forth the owner of that name, “but, oh, please do call me Cordelia. It can’t matter much to you what you call me if I’m only going to be here a little while, can it? And Anne is such an unromantic name.  <sub>[v1 c3 P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)</sub>

> I solemnly swear to be faithful to my bosom friend, Diana Barry, as long as the sun and moon shall endure.  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035)</sub>

> I shall never forgive Gilbert Blythe,” said Anne firmly. “And Mr. Phillips spelled my name without an e, too. The iron has entered into my soul, Diana.  <sub>[v1 c15 P51](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0051)</sub>

> Don’t frighten me any more than I am frightened,” implored Anne. “I’d rather walk up to a cannon’s mouth. But I’ve got to do it, Diana. It was my fault and I’ve got to confess. I’ve had practice in confessing, fortunately.  <sub>[v1 c19 P74](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0074)</sub>

> I shall take more interest than ever in my studies now,” said Anne blissfully, “because I have a purpose in life. Mr. Allan says everybody should have a purpose in life and pursue it faithfully. Only he says we must first make sure that it is a worthy purpose. I would call it a worthy purpose to want to be a teacher like Miss Stacy, wouldn’t you, Marilla? I think it’s a very noble profession.  <sub>[v1 c30 P19](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0019)</sub>
